title: Quantifying the Self-Interest Level of Markov Social Dilemmas
reasoning: The paper explores game-theoretic metrics and multi-agent reinforcement learning to quantify cooperation in social dilemmas. While concepts like 'prosocial behavior' are discussed, they are treated as mathematical constructs involving reward distribution (individual vs. collective gain) in Markov games, rather than as a benchmark or evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical systems.
